mapper.update: INSERT INTO candle_cache (symbol, interval, currency, candles_json, fetched_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{interval}, #{currency}, #{candlesJson}, #{fetchedAt}, #{expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (symbol) DO UPDATE SET interval = EXCLUDED.interval, currency = EXCLUDED.currency, candles_json = EXCLUDED.candles_json, fetched_at = EXCLUDED.fetched_at, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
